Good use of P/E and EPS together, and thanks for flagging that large-cap earnings have been weak. Two bits of context for newer viewers. 1) The 27% estimate for Q2 earnings growth is partly a low base. Nifty 50 earnings grew only about 1.2% in Q2 last year, and brokerages expect roughly 14-16% EPS growth for the full year. 2) "Cheap" depends on the window. Against five years, 18.6 is low, but the Nifty's P/E averaged about 17x in 2003-13 and about 22x since 2014, so check a longer history. Also compare the earnings yield (about 5.4%) with what government bonds pay. Not advice.

Two bits of context for newer viewers. 1) The 27% estimate for Q2 earnings growth is partly a low base. Nifty 50 earnings grew only about 1.2% in Q2 last year, and brokerages expect roughly 14-16% EPS growth for the full year. 2) "Cheap" depends on the window. Against five years, 18.6 is low, but the Nifty's P/E averaged about 17x in 2003-13 and about 22x since 2014, so check a longer history. Also compare the earnings yield (about 5.4%) with what government bonds pay. Not advice.
